_ExternalProviders: Keys for OAuth external-login providers. Each entry is registered conditionally in Program.cs — empty values mean the matching button never appears on /visuauth/login. Fill them in via `dotnet user-secrets set ExternalProviders:Microsoft:ClientId ...` (and the matching :ClientSecret) — never commit real values. Add new sub-objects for Google, Apple, GitHub, etc. and wire them in Program.cs the same way.
